crossRefs.note: When therefore they were gathered together, Pilate said to them, “Whom do you want me to release to you? Barabbas, or…
But you have a custom, that I should release someone to you at the Passover. Therefore, do you want me to release to…
Then Pilate went out again, and said to them, “Behold, I bring him out to you, that you may know that I find no basis…
Jesus therefore came out, wearing the crown of thorns and the purple garment. Pilate said to them, “Behold, the man!”
Now it was the Preparation Day of the Passover, at about the sixth hour. He said to the Jews, “Behold, your King!”
The God of Abraham, Isaac, and Jacob, the God of our fathers, has glorified his Servant Jesus, whom you delivered up…

people.name: Pilate
people.line: Roman governor who presided over Jesus' trial

translations.web: Pilate answered them, saying, “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?”
translations.bsb: “Do you want me to release to you the King of the Jews?” Pilate asked.
translations.kjv: But Pilate answered them, saying, Will ye that I release unto you the King of the Jews?
